annotations.title: Gross salary needed for a net amount in Indonesia

description: The gross yearly salary in Indonesia that leaves a given take-home pay, with the same situation options as net_salary. Use it to set a salary ask or check an offer.

combine_spouse.description: Spouse's income is combined with yours. Only when the wife has no separate NPWP; PTKP then adds 54 million. Default false.

fx_per_eur.description: Exchange rate: 1 euro = this many IDR, for the euro amounts. Default 17000 (indicative).

married.description: Married or registered partner. Default false.

period.description: Whether net_target is per year or per month. Default year.

spouse_income.description: Partner's gross yearly income in IDR, for joint taxation and spouse allowances. Default 0.

name: gross_for_target_net
title: Gross salary needed for a net amount in Indonesia
